newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM says no impact at mine from floods.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM says no impact at mine from floods.

text.p: MIM Holdings Ltd said on Monday that production and shipments from its Mount Isa copper, lead and zinc mining and smelting operations in Queensland were unaffected by recent flooding.

Floodwaters in western Queensland and north-western New South Wales have cut a number of roads, leaving towns and property owners isolated. "Production and shipments have not been affected," a MIM spokeswoman said from Mount Isa.
MIM has said it expects to produce around 360,000 tonnes of zinc concentrates in the year to June and is upgrading copper smelting capacity to around 250,000 tonnes from 175,000.
